protocol.input: Unmodified publisher RescaleT(320) and ToTensorLab(flag=0), full original EXIF-oriented RGB. No corner, mask or ROI input.
protocol.target: Whole selected paper body. Real polygons rasterized directly at stretched source pixel centres, retaining source-pixel uncertainty and occlusions. Synthetic labels from saved geometry, same across original/scene pairs. Material and corner annotations never enter loss.
protocol.architecture: Original 1,131,181-parameter U2NETP. Freeze stages 1 through 6 and every BatchNorm statistic; train decoder stages 1d through 5d, side heads and fused output.
protocol.loss: Existing per-image masked BCE-with-logits plus Dice on the fused raw logit; unknown pixels have zero gradient.
protocol.augmentation: Independent horizontal and vertical reflection of input and target together.
protocol.checkpointSelection: Final update only; no early stopping, held-out loss, alternative hyperparameters or per-photo checkpoint choices.
protocol.inference: Keep the publisher fused sigmoid head and per-image min/max normalization. No change of threshold, preprocessing or crop policy.
protocol.evaluation: Audit both final checkpoints and inspect all training outputs, then run both on the same 32-photo development cohort through the direct weighted-palette fallback, unchanged RGB classifier, ten-second fitter and independent editable/paper checks. No per-photo choices or quality gate changes.
protocol.exposure: Every original 120-update control draw retained in order; add 60 interleaved updates. Added updates use old photos in control and the eight added photos in candidate. Synthetic draws and reflections match at every step.

scope: Paired added-exposure experiment, not an exposure-only causal proof. Both arms have equal 180-update compute and preserve all old 120 visits; one allocates the added real visits to new data, the other to old data. Compare with prior 120-update results while acknowledging more optimizer updates and synthetic exposure.
